preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not exists_good_permutation(n) else all(0 <= p[i] <= n-1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If no good permutation exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all((p[i] + i) ** 0.5 == int((p[i] + i) ** 0.5) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each index i, p[i] + i must be a perfect square.
The output permutation must contain n distinct integers.
